highlights.description: Import LinkedIn data export archives (zip or extracted folder) into SQLite or PostgreSQL; repeat imports are safe and newer exports add only new records
Full-text search over every message across Inbox, Archive and Spam, with phrases, `OR`, exclusion, prefixes and grouping on both databases

added.description: `archive` package: open exports from a zip or folder, read CSV files by header name, skip preamble notes, strip byte-order marks, suffix repeated headers, and parse the export's date formats
Typed readers for messages (including `*_messages.csv` files), connections, invitations and saved items, with HTML-to-text conversion and stable content-hash keys for messages
Ent schema for import runs, people, connections, conversations, messages, invitations, saved items and raw records, with first-seen and last-seen import tracking
`store` package: open SQLite (`sqlite:<path>`, pure-Go driver) or PostgreSQL (`postgres://…`) by DSN and migrate the schema
`importer` package: idempotent import keyed by archive content hash; existing records are matched by natural key and only have their last-seen import and folder updated
Files without a typed table are preserved row by row in `raw_records`, so no export data is lost
Saved items from Complete exports, mapped by header name with unrecognized columns kept in `extra`
`search` packages: portable query syntax, SQLite FTS5 search with stemming kept in sync by triggers, and PostgreSQL full-text search with a GIN index and fully parameterized queries

knownIssues.description: Saved-item column names have not yet been confirmed against a real Complete export; unrecognized columns are kept in `saved_items.extra`
Posts, comments and reactions from Complete exports are stored only as raw records
Timestamps without a time zone, such as invitation dates, are treated as UTC

documentation.description: PRD, TRD, plan and roadmap specifications
README with usage, search syntax and library overview
MkDocs site with guides for installation, exporting, importing, searching, databases, SQL queries and the Go library

tests.description: Synthetic export fixtures and end-to-end import and search tests on in-memory SQLite, with an optional PostgreSQL run via `LIARCHIVE_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN`

infrastructure.description: GitHub Actions workflows for build and test, golangci-lint and CodeQL
